title: Looking for AppSec champions to lead community sessions for OWASP OASIS.
content_md:
Hey everyone! OWASP OASIS, an open-source security community that validates vulnerability fixes in open-source projects, is looking for volunteer leaders. https://www.owasp-oasis.org/ We've got 900+ AppSec people signed up so far. Now we're trying to turn that into an actual community, not just a sign-up list. So we're looking for volunteers to lead a few kinds of community-run sessions: Office hours: drop-in time for questions Onboarding sessions: helping new members get started Collaborative validation sessions: working through proposed fixes together as a group The process is pretty simple. You raise your hand, we train you, and then we get the sessions on the calendar. You don't need to be an expert in everything. You just need to be willing to help.
